definition.unit: world (mean over its recipes with evidence)
definition.primary: AUROC posterior - AUROC star_ppr (selected setting), focused_sample evidence, checkpoint 16, test worlds
definition.decision: posterior better if the 95% lower end is above 0; PPR better if the 95% upper end is below 0; otherwise equivalent if the 90% interval lies inside (-0.03, 0.03); otherwise inconclusive
definition.mdd: minimum detectable difference (two-sided 5%, power 80%): 2.80 x SD of the per-world differences / sqrt(worlds)
